_SecretsNote: Jwt:Key below is a DEV-ONLY PLACEHOLDER — this file is committed to a public repo and shipped inside the published server zip, so the real secret must NEVER be written here. Production deployments MUST override it via the Jwt__Key environment variable (ASP.NET Core's double-underscore convention) or a local, gitignored appsettings.Production.json. The app refuses to start in the Production environment if it still equals its placeholder value. (Security:Pepper lives only in MyriaAuthServer's appsettings.json — this realm doesn't hash passwords.)
_JwtSyncNote: This Jwt block MUST stay byte-identical to MyriaAuthServer's appsettings.json Jwt block — this realm validates tokens minted by that service purely via this shared signing key, with no live call back to it. If you change one, change all.
_AdminSyncNote: Admin:InternalSecret below is a DEV-ONLY PLACEHOLDER. It MUST stay byte-identical to MyriaAuthServer's Admin:InternalSecret — MyriaAuthServer sends it as the X-Internal-Secret header when calling this realm's /api/admin/characters/{username} endpoint on account deletion. Real value must come from the Admin__InternalSecret environment variable or a gitignored appsettings.Production.json, never this file.
_RealmDeploymentNote: This appsettings.json is a per-realm deployment file. Each realm instance needs its own Kestrel Url and ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection (own Storage/<realmid>.db), overridden via appsettings.{RealmId}.json or ASPNETCORE_URLS/ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection env vars at launch. The realm directory itself (id/name/url list) now lives on MyriaAuthServer, not here.
